summary: Phase 35 'Bulk Fetch & Local Storage' validated end-to-end. Backend bulk endpoint returns full snapshot (192 locs × 48 h × 9 params) in single payload; frontend fetches it ONCE at mount, then slices client-side. Slider scrubbing (8 positions) and param switching (5 params) produce ZERO additional /api/weather/severe/* requests, eliminating the micro-request cascade that was 504-ing the Kimsufi Atom.
critical_code_review_comments: severe.py: BULK_FILE uses Path(__file__).parent — resolves relatively as required (works in /app/backend/cache and /var/www/storm-monitor/backend/cache).

severe.py: _save_bulk_to_disk_async wraps the sync write in asyncio.to_thread; _get_or_refresh_bulk uses asyncio.create_task(...) (fire-and-forget) so disk persistence never blocks the request thread.
severe.py: _save_bulk_to_disk explicitly catches PermissionError and OSError with logger.warning (no raise) — read-only filesystem will keep in-memory mode without breaking requests.

FranceMapPanel.jsx: useEffect with empty deps [] triggers ONE bulk fetch on mount; useMemo dependencies [bulk, param, hour, cfg.valueScale, cfg.unit] guarantee pure client-side slicing for all subsequent UI changes.
api.js: getSevereGridBulk exposed at line 37; legacy getSevereGrid retained for backwards compat but not invoked by FranceMapPanel.

Minor: in dev (StrictMode) the bulk endpoint is hit twice at mount — this is expected React 18 behavior; production build will issue 1 call. Backend handles the second call from the in-memory cache (<5ms).

mount_severe_calls: /api/weather/severe/profile?lat=43.0951&lon=-0.0434&hour=0 (×2 — separate vertical profile component, not FranceMapPanel)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 35 bulk architecture is fully working. The 2 bulk calls at mount are expected (React 18 StrictMode in dev), production build will collapse to 1. Two profile calls visible at mount come from a separate vertical-profile component (not FranceMapPanel) and are also cached server-side. If a future regression introduces /api/weather/severe/grid?param=X&hour=Y calls during slider/param interaction, this means the useMemo dependencies were broken or someone re-added a useEffect with [param, hour] deps that re-calls the API.
rca of the issue: Previous iteration (28) backend was already bulk-capable but FranceMapPanel still had a useEffect calling getSevereGrid(param, hour) on every slider/param change, causing 48+ micro-requests per session. Fixed by replacing that useEffect with: (a) single useEffect([]) that calls getSevereGridBulk() once at mount, and (b) useMemo([bulk, param, hour, ...]) that slices the in-memory snapshot client-side. Backend disk write also moved off the request thread via asyncio.to_thread + create_task to protect the weak Atom CPU.
